name: opencode-harness-toolkit
description: Plugin dependencies for the SDD harness — installed into the consuming repo's .opencode/ so opencode auto-installs them for plugins/sdd-guard.ts.

scripts.build: node build/assemble.mjs opencode && node build/bundle.mjs opencode && bash scripts/gen-manifest.sh opencode
scripts.build:opencode: node build/assemble.mjs opencode && node build/bundle.mjs opencode && bash scripts/gen-manifest.sh opencode
